project_type: React 18 SPA with Vite, TypeScript, Zustand state management, Supabase backend
test_framework: Vitest with @testing-library/react, jsdom environment, vi.mock for supabase
build_command: cd frontend && unset NODE_OPTIONS && npx vite build
test_command: cd frontend && unset NODE_OPTIONS && npx vitest run
verification_instructions: 1. Run 'npx vitest run' to confirm all tests pass. 2. Run 'npx vite build' to confirm TypeScript compiles without errors. 3. Run 'npx tsc --noEmit' for type checking.
environment_constraints: COMMON_DEPENDENCIES network mode. NODE_OPTIONS must be unset before running node commands due to proxy-bootstrap preload issue. Use 'unset NODE_OPTIONS &&' prefix.
contribution_requirements: Follow existing patterns: Zustand stores with create(), fromTable() for Supabase queries, supabase.schema('perfecity').rpc() for stored functions, data-testid attributes on components, vi.mock('@/lib/supabase') in tests.
key_patterns: Stores follow pattern: State interface + Actions interface + Store type + initialState + create<Store>. Components use inline styles. Tests mock supabase via vi.mock. PublishWorkflow is the closest parallel to finalization flow (multi-step wizard). Store exports are re-exported from stores/index.ts. The supabase helper is fromTable() for table queries and supabase.schema('perfecity').rpc() for RPC calls.
directory_structure: frontend/src/stores/ (Zustand stores), frontend/src/components/ (React components grouped by feature), frontend/src/types/database.ts (all DB type definitions), frontend/src/lib/supabase.ts (Supabase client + fromTable helper), frontend/src/engines/ (calculation engines), frontend/src/pages/ (route pages)
